note: Kim evaluated the 10 'refactored' programs (5 LLMs x 2 case studies). The two 'original_base' programs (POS, SmartWallet) are the pre-refactoring source and were NOT scored in Kim's tables; they are listed for completeness. A design pattern is NOT a per-file attribute: each refactored program embodies all four patterns for its case study simultaneously, so files map to (case_study, LLM) and patterns are evaluated at the program level. The unit of scoring is therefore (case_study, LLM, pattern) = 40 units.
